objective: Implement M132's previously free 512-bit service-port assumption as a conflict-free 16-bank word-interleaved mapper that supplies sixteen consecutive 32-bit words using one read per bank.

lineage.physical_problem: M132 needs two logical 256-bit rows or sixteen 32-bit words per service cycle. M134 doubles bank count and halves logical bank depth, avoiding a second read port on every bank.

mapping.row_crossing_rule: For base bank b, banks below b read base_row+1 and banks b..15 read base_row; output rotation restores consecutive logical order.

expected_pass_line: PASS M134 conflict-free 16-bank dualrow mapper VCS legal_windows=3665 logical_words=58640 physical_bank_reads=58640 row_crossings=3435 base_offsets=16 illegal_windows=3 words=3680 banks=16 word_bits=32 service_bits=512 reads_per_bank=1 macro=false physical_speedup=false system_speedup=false headline=false
paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS exhaustively verifies every one of 3,665 legal 16-word windows in a 3,680-word PWP image: modulo-16 striping reads each of sixteen banks exactly once, generates in-range row addresses across 3,435 unaligned row crossings, and reconstructs all 58,640 logical words. SRAM macro latency, area, energy, wiring and physical speedup remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not describe conflict-free logical mapping as a fabricated or characterized 16-bank SRAM.
Do not call sixteen banks free or energy-neutral relative to eight banks.
Do not claim one-cycle macro read latency, matched frequency or physical throughput.
Do not promote M132 cycle ratios to system speedup, FPS, DATE headline or best-paper readiness.
